8. CW100 / FaithNexus100

Celebrating Christian Influence Impacting Africa

ContentWorld100 (FN100) will recognise 100 Christian leaders and voices making meaningful contributions across Africa.

Official Announcement · 29 October 2026
Vision & Purpose

Why CW100?

Influence takes many forms.

It can be expressed through ministry, business, storytelling, education, innovation, social impact, leadership and institution-building.

FN100 exists to recognise Christian voices whose work helps shape communities, industries, and the continent.

Categories

Recognition Areas

01 Faith & Ministry
02 Media & Communication
03 Arts & Entertainment
04 Education
05 Technology & Innovation
06 Business & Enterprise
07 Governance
08 Social Impact
09 Youth & Emerging Influence
10 Continental & Global Impact
Presentation Ceremony

Faith Nexus 2027 Presentation

The inaugural CW100 will be presented during Faith Nexus 2027 in Johannesburg. Further information regarding nominations, eligibility and the recognition process will be announced through official Faith Nexus channels on 29 October 2026.
